description: Inspired by the romantic realism of 19th-century painter Francis Augustus Silva, our community is where art, elegance, and everyday life come together in a striking composition.Nestled along the glistening edge of Steelpointe Harbor, The August invites you to start and end your days with panoramic sunsets that blur the line between canvas and reality. Here, golden skies melt into deep harbor blues, creating a daily masterpiece that makes coming home feel like stepping into a work of art.Our expansive pool is more than a place to unwind. It is a serene oasis surrounded by thoughtful design and subtle luxury. Whether you're lounging under sunlit skies or gathering with friends for twilight swims, every moment is painted in the colors of leisure and calm.And when the city calls, Manhattan is only a short train ride away. At The August, you're perfectly positioned between the vibrant energy of New York City and the tranquil charm of the harborfront, giving you access to both bold ambition and peaceful retreat.Inside, our apartment residences are crafted for those who appreciate the finer strokes of modern living. With open layouts, sleek finishes, and curated details, each home reflects your unique aesthetic: contemporary, confident, and creatively inspired.As a proud participant in Connecticut's Build for Connecticut program, The August offers select residences for households who qualify under the program's income guidelines. This initiative expands access to exceptional waterfront living while maintaining the elevated design, premium amenities, and vibrant lifestyle that define our community. Eligibility requirements apply. Enjoy the life you deserve. At The August, your home is more than an address. It is a gallery of experience, a curated lifestyle, and a timeless escape. Welcome to waterfront living, reimagined as art.

description: Inspired by the romantic realism of 19th-century painter Francis Augustus Silva, our community is where art, elegance, and everyday life come together in a striking composition.Nestled along the glistening edge of Steelpointe Harbor, The August invites you to start and end your days with panoramic sunsets that blur the line between canvas and reality. Whether you're lounging under sunlit skies or gathering with friends for twilight swims, every moment is painted in the colors of leisure and calm.And when the city calls, Manhattan is only a short train ride away. At The August, you're perfectly positioned between the vibrant energy of New York City and the tranquil charm of the harborfront, giving you access to both bold ambition and peaceful retreat.Inside, our apartment residences are crafted for those who appreciate the finer strokes of modern living. With open layouts, sleek finishes, and curated details, each home reflects your unique aesthetic: contemporary, confident, and creatively inspired.As a proud participant in Connecticut's Build for Connecticut program, The August offers select residences for households who qualify under the program's income guidelines. Eligibility requirements apply. Enjoy the life you deserve. At The August, your home is more than an address. It is a gallery of experience, a curated lifestyle, and a timeless escape. Welcome to waterfront living, reimagined as art.

description: Bella Vista is designed for carefree, secure and active Senior Living Community. The property is located 5 miles outside of the Central Business District of New Haven on a ridge crest in a wooded setting. You can choose from bright, spacious efficiencies, one or two bedroom apartments that include free utilities, making budgeting easy for fixed-income seniors. The grounds of Bella Vista are spectacular. The site offers community gardens, picnic area, bocce ball and horseshoe courts and walking paths throughout the property. Our residents gather in the attractive gazebos or community rooms to socialize, make plans, and take in the views. Recreational activities occur regularly and include an on-site exercise facility complete with aerobic cardio exercise machines, on-premise events and celebrations as well as outings to area attractions, casinos and cultural events. There is an on-site City of New Haven Senior Center, library and services for various religious denominations, in addition to our own Resident Services Office. Bella Vista is not only on the Connecticut Transit bus line, but also an actual terminal stop for several Greater New Haven bus routes. Bella Vista also offers a weekday shopping bus free of charge to residents. Convenient retail outlets located in our community make shopping for necessities even easier for residents who prefer staying closer to home. Residents can go grocery shopping, visit the full-service pharmacy, or do their banking right here on site all before an appointment at the beauty/barber shop, or meeting friends for breakfast or lunch at the Bella Vista Deli. Bella Vista's health care center includes a medical group specializing in internal and geriatric medicine, a diagnostic lab, physical therapy office, professional podiatric foot care, home health care services and a medical equipment supplier. Bella Vista is located on a public bus system line that serves all of New Haven and most cities and towns in the Greater New Haven

The grounds of Bella Vista are spectacular. The site offers community gardens, picnic area, bocce ball and horseshoe courts and walking paths throughout the property. Our residents gather in the attractive gazebos or community rooms to socialize, make plans, and take in the views. Recreational activities occur regularly and include an on-site exercise facility complete with aerobic cardio exercise machines, on-premise events and celebrations as well as outings to area attractions, casinos and cultural events. There is an on-site City of New Haven Senior Center, library and services for various religious denominations, in addition to our own Resident Services Office. Bella Vista is not only on the Connecticut Transit bus line, but also an actual terminal stop for several Greater New Haven bus routes. Bella Vista also offers a weekday shopping bus free of charge to residents. Convenient retail outlets located in our community make shopping for necessities even easier for residents who prefer staying closer to home. Residents can go grocery shopping, visit the full-service pharmacy, or do their banking right here on site all before an appointment at the beauty/barber shop, or meeting friends for breakfast or lunch at the Bella Vista Deli. Bella Vista's health care center includes a medical group specializing in internal and geriatric medicine, a diagnostic lab, physical therapy office, professional podiatric foot care, home health care services and a medical equipment supplier. Bella Vista is located on a public bus system line that serves all of New Haven and most cities and towns in
